subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should auto TTS keep using other configured speech providers as fallbacks when the selected provider is skipped or fails, or should OpenClaw expose provider stickiness for configured providers?
rationale: Current docs and code make fallback deliberate, but this report shows the behavior can surprise users and has billing/voice-identity implications that automation should not decide as a default policy change.

options.title: Add opt-in provider stickiness
options.body: Keep fallback as the compatibility default, but expose a documented strict mode that fails visibly instead of playing another provider when the selected provider cannot be used.

options.title: Keep fallback-only behavior
options.body: Treat the remaining behavior as expected and improve docs/status messaging enough that users understand why OpenAI may play.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Make configured TTS providers sticky by default and require upgrade communication because existing fallback setups may stop producing audio.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in provider stickiness
recommendation.body: Keep fallback as the compatibility default, but expose a documented strict mode that fails visibly instead of playing another provider when the selected provider cannot be used.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and older TTS provider/config history make this the strongest available routing signal for a cross-cutting fallback-policy decision.
